title: Sandia history lists Kissinger as a seminar expert at Kirtland

tellings.quote: As part of his work, Carter organized interdisciplinary seminars featuring noted international experts and specialists, one of them, Henry Kissinger.

plain: A redacted internal history of Sandia Laboratories, a US nuclear weapons laboratory at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, names Henry Kissinger, the future American statesman, as one of the experts at seminars held there. Michels reads from it himself: "Carter organized interdisciplinary seminars featuring noted international experts and specialists, one of them, Henry Kissinger," Carter being a man named Don Carter. Michels raises it while asking whether Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs, since it would place him at a key nuclear site early on.
